_note: Ideology camps: neutral groupings drawn on the quiz's own axes (-2..+2). A camp lists only the axes that define it; the player's camp is the nearest centroid (RMS over those axes) inside the route's party. fit % = 100 x (1 - rms / 3), floored at 0.

camps.name: Insurgent left
camps.blurb: Tax the rich, primary the cautious, post through it.

camps.name: Kitchen-table populists
camps.blurb: Wages, rent and drug prices first; culture war a distant second.

camps.name: Big-tent liberals
camps.blurb: Blue-state confidence, a camera ready, a fight picked daily.

camps.name: Party institutionalists
camps.blurb: Wait your turn, trust the process, never say anything clippable.

camps.name: Governing centrists
camps.blurb: Fix the road, win the swing county, keep the base at arm's length.

camps.name: National populists
camps.blurb: Tariffs, a hard border, no more wars and absolute loyalty to the leader.

camps.name: Disruptor right
camps.blurb: Fire the bureaucracy, deregulate everything, launch it from a podcast.

camps.name: Movement conservatives
camps.blurb: Culture war as governing program, run from the statehouse.

camps.name: Libertarian right
camps.blurb: Audit the Fed, end the wars, leave me alone.

camps.name: Statehouse conservatives
camps.blurb: Low taxes, quiet competence, a fleece vest and no tweets.

camps.name: Defense hawks
camps.blurb: Peace through strength, sanctions by Friday, a carrier group for every crisis.

camps.name: Faith-first conservatives
camps.blurb: Scripture before strategy, and a long memory for who kept their vows.
